title: MUSCLE MANGA - Adam "The Emperor" Dudley's Physique in Kengan Ashura
summary: Muscle Manga episode on Adam Dudley from Kengan Ashura: a top-heavy American brawler and former NHL enforcer whose oversized arms and abnormally thick core and lower back let him knock people out without using his legs. NH walks through his fight with jiu-jitsu prodigy Imai Cosmo, who wins by choke while Dudley hallucinates his victory, as a showcase of how effective grappling is.
claims: Adam Dudley is listed at 107 kg and 192 cm: not an outlier in size, but his anatomy stands out
Dudley's arms and shoulders are topped only by Julius in size and Kuroki in definition; his biggest strength is a huge core with an 8-pack
Brawlers lose most of their striking power on their back because punching power comes mostly from the hips
In the manga, Dudley's punching power comes from a trunk, core and lower back several times thicker than a normal man's, which lets him KO people without his lower body
His trunk is so rigid he can do a full-range sit-up with only a slight knee bend
The fight shows the effectiveness of grappling in MMA: Imai Cosmo wins by submission while Dudley hallucinates from lack of oxygen
